claims.statement: Coins App 3083090 is attributed by its public store to CoinsDev, released 2024-08-02.
claims.claimCeiling: Product description, not corporate identity due diligence.

claims.statement: The supplied image labels Arsenic while its item description begins Antimony.
claims.claimCeiling: Visual wording only; no cause or author attribution.
claims.reopenTrigger: Developer correction or exact current public item metadata.

claims.statement: Steam Wallet and Market were publicly announced in 2010 and 2012.
claims.claimCeiling: Existence of announcements, not all users' awareness.

claims.statement: Public documentation supports a platform-managed item economy.
claims.claimCeiling: Generic architecture and this app's public description, not full private app configuration.
claims.reopenTrigger: Developer-published current issue and configuration policy.

claims.statement: A secret Bitcoin-like Coins protocol is not established in this source set.
claims.claimCeiling: No global impossibility claim; coin imagery does not bind a network protocol.
claims.reopenTrigger: Public protocol, independently inspectable ledger and consensus specifications.

claims.statement: Market proceeds are Steam Wallet credit and the documented Market does not cash them out to a bank.
claims.claimCeiling: Documented platform function; not a finding about every third-party market or statutory remedy.

claims.statement: Unused Wallet credit purchased directly on Steam has a separate fourteen-day refund-request rule.
claims.claimCeiling: Qualification in official refund policy, not market-profit cash-out.
claims.reopenTrigger: Changed refund policy or case-specific legally established exception.

claims.statement: The Alchemy product describes two random items from eleven variants; individual odds were not located in the short page.
claims.claimCeiling: Limited page coverage; not proof that no odds are disclosed elsewhere.
claims.reopenTrigger: Published odds, all sales terms or developer clarification.

claims.statement: News and an indexed operator statement report achievement visibility on Exophase.
claims.claimCeiling: Reported occurrence; no direct technical root-cause test.
claims.reopenTrigger: Public operator or Valve technical incident statement.

claims.statement: Exact MSN body, publisher match and date remain unresolved.
claims.claimCeiling: Link and title are available; full body retrieval was unsuccessful.
claims.reopenTrigger: Readably retrieved canonical article with byline and timestamp.

claims.statement: The requester's claim to causing the leak is not established by the supplied image or investigated sources.
claims.claimCeiling: Attribution ceiling for this finite inquiry, not a universal negative claim.
claims.reopenTrigger: Earlier lawfully supplied original record tied to the same specific incident.

claims.statement: A full present Coins portfolio value or future appreciation was not computed.
claims.claimCeiling: No current exact item orderbook, executed sale, issue cap or fee schedule was obtained.
claims.reopenTrigger: Bounded public market snapshot with executable depth and app-specific fees.

claims.statement: The given display date does not prove the account will be eligible for every trade then.
claims.claimCeiling: Displayed date retained with timezone UNKNOWN; no account access.
claims.reopenTrigger: User-authorized current eligibility evidence or relevant public restriction.

claims.statement: Clear odds, issuance policies, net proceeds and metadata correction would improve the proposed transparency design.
claims.claimCeiling: Author's design proposal, not demonstrated outcome or existing legal obligation.
claims.reopenTrigger: User testing, voluntary implementation and measured comprehension.

claims.statement: Selected local text and public Git history searches found no earlier matching Coins audit.
claims.claimCeiling: Finite selected coverage; the different How to Fish report is not a Coins precursor proof.
claims.reopenTrigger: Concrete older file, commit or public source supplied for comparison.
